55700.commentary: (DNa) lahusā'ti lahukā. appaken'eva tussanti vā dussanti vā udakapiṭṭhe alābukaṭāhaṃ viya appaken'eva uplavanti.

examples.text: caṇḍā, bho gotama, sakyajāti, pharusā, bho gotama, sakyajāti, lahusā, bho gotama, sakyajāti, bhassā, bho gotama, sakyajāti, ibbhā santā ibbhā samānā na brāhmaṇe sakkaronti, na brāhmaṇe garuṃ karonti, na brāhmaṇe mānenti, na brāhmaṇe pūjenti, na brāhmaṇe apacāyanti.

55701.meaning1: perception of lightness; awareness of buoyancy
55701.commentary: (SNa) sukhasaññañ'ca lahusaññañ'cā'ti abhiññācittasahajātasaññā. sā hi santasukhasamannāgatattā sukhasaññā nāma hoti, kilesadandhāyitattassa ca abhāvā lahusaññā nāma.

examples.text: yasmiṃ, ānanda, samaye tathāgato kāyam'pi citte samodahati cittam'pi kāye samodahati, sukhasaññañ'ca lahusaññañ'ca kāye okkamitvā viharati, tasmiṃ, ānanda, samaye tathāgatassa kāyo lahutaro c'eva hoti mudutaro ca kammaniyataro ca pabhassarataro ca.

55702.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of lahu

55703.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of lahu

examples.text: siñca bhikkhu imaṃ nāvaṃ, sittā te lahum'essati, chetvā rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca, tato nibbānam'ehisi.

atha naṃ rājā ādāsehi parikkhipāpesi. so attano'va chāyaṃ disvā ñātakā me āgatā'ti maññamāno pakkhena tāḷaṃ datvā mañjussarena maṇivaṃsaṃ dhamamāno viya viravi. sakalanagare manussā mattā viya laḷiṃsu.
yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, sattā kāmesu laḷitā. asitabyābhaṅgiṃ, bhikkhave, kulaputto ohāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, saddhāpabbajito kulaputto'ti alaṃ vacanāya.

55709.meaning1: lac; shellac; red dye obtained from insect resin
55709.notes: Possibly from Sanskrit lakṣa 'one hundred thousand' owing to the large numbers of insects which product the resinous substance.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rajako vā cittakārako vā rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā suparimaṭṭhe phalake vā bhittiyā vā dussapaṭṭe vā itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ.
seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto saṃsaṭṭho lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā.

tassa kira kāyo setapokkharasadiso devanagare ussāpitarajatatoraṇaṃ viya sobhati, sīsaṃ pan'assa kāḷavaṇṇa-indanīlamayaṃ viya, massu'pi candamaṇḍale kāḷamegharāji viya khāyati, akkhīni nīl'uppalasadisāni, nāsā rajatapanāḷikā viya suvaṭṭitā suparisuddhā, hatthapādatalāni c'eva mukhañ'ca katalākhārasaparikammaṃ viya sobhati. ativiya sobhaggappatto brāhmaṇassa attabhāvo.

rājā sālīhi atthe sati āharissasi, ehi gacchāmā'ti sattatiyā hiraññakoṭīhi saddhiṃ te tayo'pi jane gāhāpetvā nagaraṃ gantvā pāsādavare mahātalaṃ āruyhaṃ dhanaṃ saṅgopetvā sappassa vasan'atthāya suvaṇṇanāḷiṃ, undūrassa phalikaguhaṃ, suvassa suvaṇṇapañjaraṃ kārāpetvā sappassa ca suvassa ca bhojanatthāya devasikaṃ kañcanataṭṭake madhulāje, undūrassa gandhasālitaṇḍule dāpesi, dān'ādīni ca puññāni karoti.

55713.meaning2: having parched corn as the fifth

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, sakuṇagghi lāpaṃ sakuṇaṃ sahasā ajjhappattā aggahesi.
so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, tāvataken'eva oṭṭhapahatamattena lapitalāpanamattena ñāṇavādañ'ca vadāmi theravādañ'ca, jānāmi passāmī'ti ca paṭijānāmi, ahañ'c'eva aññe ca.
aniccā, bhikkhave, kāmā tucchā musā mosadhammā. māyākatam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bālalāpanaṃ.
etādis'āyaṃ santāno, māy'āyaṃ bālalāpinī, vadhako esa akkhāto, sāro ettha na vijjati.

55718.commentary: (SaPM) iti alābu lābusaddā viya aggini ginisaddāpi bhagavato pācane dissantī'ti veditabbā. (APt) napubbo lamba avasaṃsane, u, malopo, nassa attaṃ, alābu, pāṇiniyānaṃ, āpubbo lamba avasaṃsane, ālābu.
55718.sanskrit: alābu, alābū, alābuka, alābukā, ālābu, alāmbu

examples.text: yathā, mahārāja, lābulatā tiṇe vā kaṭṭhe vā latāya vā soṇḍikāhi ālambitvā tassūpari vaḍḍhati, evam'eva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yog'āvacarena arahatte abhivaḍḍhitu'kāmena manasā ārammaṇaṃ ālambitvā arahatte abhivaḍḍhitabbaṃ.

55719.sanskrit: alābu, alābū, alābuka, alābukā, ālābu, alāmbu

examples.text: idāni yasmā ayaṃ paribbājako kañjiyen'eva tittak'ālābu, ucchedadassanen'eva pūrito, so yathā kañjiyaṃ appahāya na sakkā lābumhi telaphāṇit'ādīni pakkhipituṃ, pakkhittāni'pi na gaṇhāti

55720.meaning2: outer crust of a gourd used as a vessel

examples.text: ārogyaparamā lābhā, santuṭṭhiparamaṃ dhanaṃ, vissāsaparamā ñāti, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ.
āsīsanti thomayanti abhijappanti juhanti, kām'ābhijappanti paṭicca lābhaṃ, te yājayogā bhavarāgarattā, n'ātariṃsu jātijaran'ti brūmi.
evaṃ mayaṃ aññam'aññaṃ guttā aññam'aññaṃ rakkhitā sippāni c'eva dassessāma, lābhañ'ca lacchāma, sotthinā ca caṇḍālavaṃsā orohissāmā'ti.

55725.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of lābhakamya
55725.meaning1: from a desire for gain; out of desire for profit
55725.commentary: (SNPa) lābhakamyā na sikkhatī'ti na lābhapatthanāya sutt'ant'ādīni sikkhati. (SNPa) lābhakamyā janaṃ na lapayeyyā'ti lābhakāmatāya janaṃ nālapayeyya.

examples.text: lābhakamyā na sikkhati, alābhe ca na kuppati, aviruddho ca taṇhāya, rasesu n'ānugijjhati.
kayavikkaye na tiṭṭheyya, upavādaṃ bhikkhu na kareyya kuhiñci, gāme ca n'ābhisajjeyya, lābhakamyā janaṃ na lapayeyya.

55726.meaning1: wanting material benefit; greedy for gain

examples.text: kassapassa, bhikkhave, kulāni upasaṅkamato kulesu cittaṃ na sajjati na gayhati na bajjhati, labhantu lābhakāmā, puññakāmā karontu puññānī'ti, yathāsakena lābhena attamano hoti sumano, evaṃ paresaṃ lābhena attamano hoti sumano.
lābhakāmā bhavissanti, kusītā hīnavīriyā, kicchantā vanapatthāni, gām'antesu vasissare.

55728.meaning1: valuing material gain; giving weight to profit
55728.commentary: (ANa) kodhagaru na saddhammagarū'ti kodhaṃ gāravena garuṃ katvā gaṇhāti, na saddhammaṃ, saddhammaṃ pana agāravena lāmakaṃ katvā gaṇhāti. sesapadesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: katame cattāro? kodhagaru na saddhammagaru, makkhagaru na saddhammagaru, lābhagaru na saddhammagaru, sakkāragaru na saddhammagaru. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.

55729.meaning1: fact of valuing material gain; fact of giving weight to profit

examples.text: katame cattāro? kodhagarutā na saddhammagarutā, makkhagarutā na saddhammagarutā, lābhagarutā na saddhammagarutā, sakkāragarutā na saddhammagarutā. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro asaddhammā.

55730.meaning1: pinnacle of acquisition; summit of material support; highest gain
55730.commentary: (MNa) lābh'aggan'ti lābhassa aggaṃ. saṅgho hi yāva na lābh'aggapatto hoti, na tāva lābhaṃ paṭicca āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā uppajjanti. patte pana uppajjanti, atha satthā sikkhāpadaṃ paññapeti

examples.text: na tāva, bhaddāli, idh'ekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti yāva na saṅgho lābh'aggaṃ patto hoti, yas'aggaṃ patto hoti, bāhusaccaṃ patto hoti, rattaññutaṃ patto hoti.

55731.meaning1: reached the peak of material gain
55731.commentary: (DNa) lābh'aggappatto'ti lābh'aggaṃ patto, aggalābhaṃ patto'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: atha naṃ bodhisatto yakkhabhāve ādīnavaṃ kathetvā pañcasu sīlesu patiṭṭhāpesi. so tena susaṃvihitārakkho tasmiṃ araññe vasitvā pitari kālakate yakkhaṃ ādāya bārāṇasiṃ gantvā rajjaṃ gahetvā candakumārassa uparajjaṃ, sūriyakumārassa senāpatiṭṭhānaṃ datvā yakkhassa ramaṇīye ṭhāne āyatanaṃ kārāpetvā yathā so lābh'aggappatto hoti, tathā akāsi.

55732.meaning1: great material gain; (comm) (or) foremost position in material gain
55732.commentary: (VINa) lābh'aggamahattan'ti lābhassa aggamahattaṃ. yo lābhassa aggo uttamo mahantabhāvo, taṃ patto hotī'ti attho. lābhena vā aggamahattam'pi, lābhena seṭṭhattañ'ca mahantattañ'ca patto'ti attho.

55733.meaning1: reached the peak of material gain and fame
55733.commentary: (SNt) lābh'aggayas'aggappattan'ti lābhassa ca yasassa ca aggaṃ ukkaṃsaṃ pattaṃ.

examples.text: brahmacariyañcassa hoti iddhañ'c'eva phītañ'ca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitaṃ, no ca kho lābh'agga-yas'aggappattaṃ. evaṃ taṃ brahmacariyaṃ aparipūraṃ hoti ten'aṅgena.

55734.meaning1: diversity of gains; variety of acquisitions

examples.text: saññānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saṅkappanānattaṃ, saṅkappanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandanānattaṃ, chandanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati pariḷāhanānattaṃ, pariḷāhanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati pariyesanānānattaṃ, pariyesanānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati lābhanānattaṃ. ime nava dhammā duppaṭivijjhā.

55735.meaning1: end of material gain; cessation of acquisition
55735.meaning2: end of material gain; cessation of acquisition

examples.text: lābho ca hi, ānanda, n'ābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, sabbaso lābhe asati lābhanirodhā api nu kho vinicchayo paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

katamesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ? dāyakassa puññ'antarāyakaro hoti, paṭiggāhakānaṃ lābh'antarāyakaro hoti, pubb'eva kho pan'assa attā khato ca hoti upahato ca. yo kho, vaccha, paraṃ dānaṃ dadantaṃ vāreti so imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ antarāyakaro hoti, tiṇṇaṃ pāripanthiko.

55737.meaning1: stinginess with material gains; selfishness with acquisitions
55737.commentary: (DNa) lābhe macchariyaṃ lābhamacchariyaṃ. tena samannāgato bhikkhu saṅghikam'pi lābhaṃ maccharāyanto yathā aññe na labhanti, evaṃ karoti.

examples.text: pañca macchariyāni, āvāsamacchariyaṃ, kulamacchariyaṃ, lābhamacchariyaṃ, vaṇṇamacchariyaṃ, dhammamacchariyaṃ.

55738.meaning1: stingy with material gains; selfish about acquisitions
55738.commentary: (ANa) lābhamaccharinī'ti lābhaṃ maccharāyati, aññesaṃ taṃ uppajjantaṃ na sahati.

examples.text: āvāsamaccharinī hoti, kulamaccharinī hoti, lābhamaccharinī hoti, vaṇṇamaccharinī hoti, dhammamaccharinī hoti. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgatā bhikkhunī yath'ābhataṃ nikkhittā evaṃ niraye.

55739.meaning1: gain and honour; material support and acclaim; acquisitions and esteem
55739.commentary: (VINt) uḷāro lābhasakkāro'ti ettha labbhati pāpuṇīyatīti lābho, catunnaṃ paccayānametaṃ adhivacanaṃ. sakkaccaṃ kātabbo dātabbo'ti sakkāro, cattāro paccayāyeva. paccayā eva hi paṇītapaṇītā sundarasundarā abhisaṅkharitvā katā sakkāro'ti vuccanti. atha vā parehi kātabbagāravakiriyā pupphādīhi pūjā vā sakkāro.

examples.text: na'y'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ lābhasakkārasilok'ānisaṃsaṃ na sīlasampad'ānisaṃsaṃ na samādhisampad'ānisaṃsaṃ na ñāṇadassan'ānisaṃsaṃ

ayaṃ pan'ettha saṅkhepo, bhagavato kira bhikkhusaṅghassa ca pañcannaṃ mahānadīnaṃ mah'oghasadise lābhasakkāre uppanne hatalābhasakkārā aññatitthiyā sūriy'uggamanakāle khajjopanakā viya nippabhā hutvā ekato sannipatitvā mantayiṃsu.

55740.meaning1: valuing gain and honour; respecting profit and accolades

examples.text: kodhamakkhagarū bhikkhū, lābhasakkāragāravā, na te dhamme virūhanti, sammāsambuddhadesite.
anavaññattisaṃyutto, lābhasakkāragāravo, sahanandī amaccehi, ārā saṃyojanakkhayā.

55741.meaning1: wanting gain and honour; desiring possessions and respect

examples.text: kuhakā'ti-ādīsu tividhena kuhanavatthunā lokaṃ kuhayanti, vimhāpayantī'ti kuhakā. lābhasakkār'atthikā hutvā lapantī'ti lapakā.

55743.meaning1: gain, honour and fame; possessions, respect and popularity
55743.compound: dvanda (lābha ca sakkāra ca siloka ca)

examples.text: dāruṇo, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.
na'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ vussati janakuhan'atthaṃ, na janalapan'atthaṃ, na lābhasakkārasiloka-ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na itivādappamokkh'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na iti maṃ jano jānātū'ti

55744.meaning1: out of a desire for gain, honour and fame; for the purpose of possessions, respect and popularity

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati lābhasakkārasiloka-nikantihetu, sakkarissanti maṃ rājāno rājamah'āmattā khattiyā brāhmaṇā gahapatikā titthiyā'ti

55745.meaning1: due to the defilement of craving gain, honour and fame
55745.sanskrit: lābha + satkāra + śloka + nikāmana + saṃdosa + hetu

examples.text: ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā lābhasakkārasilokaṃ nikāmayamānā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, lābha-sakkāra-siloka-nikāmana-sandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.

ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā lābhasakkārasilokaṃ nikāmayamānā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, lābhasakkārasilokanikāmanasandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.

55747.meaning1: cessation of gain, honour and fame

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā lābhasakkārasilokaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti, lābhasakkārasilokasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, lābhasakkārasilokanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, lābhasakkārasilokanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti…

55748.meaning1: leading to the cessation of gain, honour and fame

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā lābhasakkārasilokaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti, lābhasakkārasilokasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, lābhasakkārasilokanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, lābhasakkārasilokanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti…

55749.meaning2: concerning with gain honour and fame; about possessions renown and popularity

examples.text: amarā-vitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ par'ānudayatā-paṭisaṃyutta-vitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ lābha-sakkāra-siloka-paṭisaṃyutta-vitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ

55750.meaning1: getting gain, honour and fame; acquiring possessions, respect and popularity
55750.commentary: (ANa) lābha-sakkāra-siloka-ppaṭilābhāyā'ti susaṅkhata-catupaccaya-saṅkhātassa lābhasakkārassa c'eva vaṇṇabhaṇanasaṅkhātassa silokassa ca paṭilābh'atthāya.

examples.text: so uṭṭhahati ghaṭati vāyamati anavaññappaṭilābhāya lābha-sakkāra-siloka-ppaṭilābhāya.

55751.meaning1: arising of gain, honour and fame

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā lābhasakkārasilokaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti, lābhasakkārasilokasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, lābhasakkārasilokanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, lābhasakkārasilokanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti…

55752.meaning1: pleasure of gain, honour and fame; pleasure of possessions, respect and popularity

examples.text: yo kho, nāgita, na'y'imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī… so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyā'ti.

55753.meaning1: who has gain, honour and fame; who has possessions, respect and popularity
55753.construction:
lābha + sakkāra + siloka + vant
lābhasakkārasiloka + vant

examples.text: so tena lābhasakkārasilokena attamano hoti paripuṇṇasaṅkappo. so tena lābhasakkārasilokena attān'ukkaṃseti paraṃ vambheti, aham'asmi lābhasakkārasilokavā, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū appaññātā app'esakkhā'ti.

55754.meaning1: for the benefit of gain, honour and fame; for the advantage of possessions, respect and popularity

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, na'y'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ lābhasakkārasilok'ānisaṃsaṃ, na sīlasampad'ānisaṃsaṃ, na samādhisampad'ānisaṃsaṃ, na ñāṇadassan'ānisaṃsaṃ. yā ca kho ayaṃ, bhikkhave, akuppā cetovimutti, etadattham'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ, etaṃ sāraṃ etaṃ pariyosānan'ti.

55755.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of lābhasakkārasilokānisaṃsattha
55755.meaning1: for the sake of the benefit of gain, honour and fame
55755.constructionSummary: lābha + sakkāra + siloka + ānisaṃsa + attha + aṃ
55755.construction:
lābha + sakkāra + siloka + ānisaṃsa + attha + aṃ
lābhasakkārasilokānisaṃsattha + aṃ
55755.sanskrit: lābha + satkāra + śloka + ānṛśaṃsa, anuśaṃsa (bsk) + artham

examples.text: na'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ vussati janakuhan'atthaṃ, na janalapan'atthaṃ, na lābha-sakkāra-silok'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na itivādappamokkh'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na iti maṃ jano jānātū'ti.

55757.meaning1: it is a gain; it's good; it's a blessing (for)
55757.meaning2: it is profitable, it is a gain

examples.text: alābhā vata me, na vata me lābhā, dulladdhaṃ vata me, na vata me suladdhaṃ, yassa me anabhirati uppannā
lābhā no, āvuso, suladdhaṃ no, āvuso, ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ passāma.

55758.lemma: lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
55758.grammar: idiom, ind + ind + pron + ind + ind + pron
55758.meaning1: it's certainly a gain for me, a great benefit for me; it's my good luck, my good fortune; it's a blessing for me, a great blessing

examples.text: idha mayhaṃ, bhante, evaṃ hoti, lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me, yo'haṃ evarūpehi sabrahmacārīhi saddhiṃ viharāmī'ti

55759.meaning1: excellence of gain; best kind of material acquisition
55759.commentary: (DNa) maṇiratan'ādi-lābho na lābh'ānuttariyaṃ, sattavidha-ariyadhanalābho pana lābh'ānuttariyaṃ nāma.

examples.text: cha anuttariyāni, dassan'ānuttariyaṃ, savan'ānuttariyaṃ, lābh'ānuttariyaṃ, sikkh'ānuttariyaṃ, pāricariy'ānuttariyaṃ, anussat'ānuttariyaṃ.

55760.meaning1: gain and loss; profit and loss

examples.text: so lābhasakkāraṃ jigucchanto pabbajjaṃ anupagantvā, pahomi c'āhaṃ lābh'ālābh'ādīsu nibbikāro hotun'ti attānaṃ takkento, visesato para-paribhava-sahan'ādi-paṭipadaṃ pūrento upekkhāpāramiṃ matthakaṃ pāpessāmī'ti

55761.meaning1: desire for (material) gain; expectation of acquisition
55761.commentary: (ANa) āsā'ti taṇhā. duppajahā'ti duccajā dunnīharā. lābh'āsāya duppajahabhāvena sattā dasa'pi vassāni vīsati'pi saṭṭhi'pi vassāni ajja labhissāma, sve labhissāmā'ti rājānaṃ upaṭṭhahanti, kasikamm'ādīni karonti, ubhatobyūḷhaṃ saṅgāmaṃ pakkhandanti, ajapatha-saṅkupath'ādayo paṭipajjanti, nāvāya mahāsamuddaṃ pavisanti. jīvit'āsāya duppajahattā sampatte maraṇakāle'pi vassasatajīviṃ attānaṃ maññanti. so kammakammanimitt'ādīni passanto'pi dānaṃ dehi pūjaṃ, karohī'ti anukampakehi vuccamāno n'āhaṃ marissāmi, jīvissāmi'cc'eva āsāya kassaci vacanaṃ na gaṇhāti.

examples.text: lābh'āsā ca jīvit'āsā ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve āsā duppajahā'ti.

55762.meaning1: fact of being someone who possesses; state of being one who gains

examples.text: ṭīkāyaṃ ca, pāḷiyaṃ rāmass'eva samāpattilābhitā āgatā na udakassā'ti ādi pacchābhāge pakāsitā.

55763.meaning1: who gains; who gets; who has

examples.text: kiṃ nu kho mayaṃ āyasmato anuruddhassa evam'ārocimha, imāsañ'ca imāsañ'ca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ mayaṃ lābhino'ti
so ca hoti dubbaṇṇo duddasiko okoṭimako bavh'ābādho kāṇo vā kuṇī vā khañjo vā pakkhahato vā, na lābhī annassa pānassa vatthassa yānassa mālāgandhavilepanassa seyyāvasathapadīpeyyassa.

55764.meaning1: I get; I gain; I have

examples.text: sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti, lābhī'mhi ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, na lābhī adhipaññā-dhammavipassanāyā'ti, tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā ajjhattaṃ cetosamathe patiṭṭhāya adhipaññā-dhammavipassanāya yogo karaṇīyo.

55765.meaning2: seeking a gift by offering a gift

examples.text: kuhanā, lapanā, nemittikatā, nippesikatā, lābhena lābhaṃ nijigiṃsanatā, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, micchā-ājīvo

55766.meaning1: seeking a gift by offering a gift
55766.commentary: (MNa) lābhena lābhaṃ nijigīsanti magganti pariyesantī'ti lābhena lābhaṃ nijigīsanā, tesaṃ bhāvo lābhena lābhaṃ nijigīsanatā.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, micchāājīvo? kuhanā, lapanā, nemittikatā, nippesikatā, lābhena lābhaṃ nijigisanatā, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, micchāājīvo.

55767.meaning1: in the manner of seeking a gift by offering a gift

examples.text: jīvitaṃ aḍḍhānaṃ jīvitaṃ upādāya daliddānaṃ jīvitaṃ pāpakaṃ lāmakaṃ, sadhanānaṃ jīvitaṃ upādāya adhanānaṃ jīvitaṃ pāpakaṃ, devānaṃ jīvitaṃ upādāya manussānaṃ jīvitaṃ pāpakaṃ.

55771.meaning1: name of a group of deities

examples.text: khemiyā tusitā yāmā, kaṭṭhakā ca yasassino, lambītakā lāmaseṭṭhā, jotināmā ca āsavā, nimmānaratino āguṃ, ath'āguṃ paranimmitā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pabbajalāyako pabbajaṃ lāyitvā agge gahetvā odhunāti niddhunāti nicchoṭeti

55777.meaning1: having reaped; having mowed; having cut

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pabbajalāyako pabbajaṃ lāyitvā agge gahetvā odhunāti niddhunāti nicchoṭeti

55782.meaning1: inarticulate speech; wailing; moaning; (comm) speaking again and again
55782.meaning2: inarticulate or empty talk; wailing; murmuring

examples.text: dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa ādevo paridevo ādevanā paridevanā ādevitattaṃ paridevitattaṃ palāpo vippalāpo lālappo lālappanā lālappitattaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati paridevo.

55783.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from lālappati, intens
55783.meaning2: inarticulate or empty talk; wailing; murmuring

examples.text: ādevitattaṃ paridevitattaṃ palāpo vippalāpo lālappo lālappanā lālappitattaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati paridevo.

55784.meaning1: fact of wailing inarticulately; fact of mumbling incoherently
55784.meaning2: inarticulate or empty talk; wailing; murmuring; lit. murmuring state

examples.text: ādevitattaṃ paridevitattaṃ palāpo vippalāpo lālappo lālappanā lālappitattaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati paridevo.

55785.commentary: (DNt) eḷā gaḷantī'ti vuttass'eva dvidhā atthaṃ dassetuṃ lālā vā paggharantī'ti-ādi vuttaṃ.

examples.text: anelagalāyā'ti elagaḷenavirahitāya. yassa kassaci hi kathentassa elā gaḷanti, lālā vā paggharanti, kheḷaphusitāni vā nikkhamanti, tassa vācā elagaḷaṃ nāma hoti, tabbiparitāyā'ti attho.

55788.meaning2: having lulled, having quelled, having soothed

55792.commentary: (VINa) lāsentī'ti pītiyā uppilavamānā viya uṭṭhahitvā lāsiyanāṭakaṃ nāṭenti, recakaṃ denti.

examples.text: vikāle'pi bhuñjanti, majjam'pi pivanti, mālāgandhavilepanam'pi dhārenti, naccanti'pi gāyanti'pi vādenti'pi lāsenti'pi, naccantiyā'pi naccanti, naccantiyā'pi gāyanti, naccantiyā'pi vādenti, naccantiyā'pi lāsenti
vādentiyā'pi naccanti, vādentiyā'pi gāyanti, vādentiyā'pi vādenti, vādentiyā'pi lāsenti, lāsentiyā'pi naccanti, lāsentiyā'pi gāyanti, lāsentiyā'pi vādenti, lāsentiyā'pi lāsenti.

55795.meaning2: egg of a louse, measure named after it

examples.text: sākhāpalāsaṃ suvisodhitaṃ visodhetvā kuṭhārīhi taccheyya, kuṭhārīhi tacchetvā vāsīhi taccheyya, vāsīhi tacchetvā lekhaṇiyā likheyya, lekhaṇiyā likhitvā pāsāṇaguḷena dhoveyya, pāsāṇaguḷena dhovetvā nadiṃ patāreyya.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso āgaccheyya lākhaṃ vā haliddiṃ vā nīlaṃ vā mañjiṭṭhaṃ vā ādāya. so evaṃ vadeyya, ahaṃ imasmiṃ ākāse rūpaṃ likhissāmi, rūpapātubhāvaṃ karissāmī'ti.

dīghaṃ vā añchanto'ti mahantānaṃ bherīpokkhar'ādīnaṃ likhanakāle hatthe ca pāde ca pasāretvā dīghaṃ kaḍḍhanto. rassaṃ vā añchanto'ti khuddakānaṃ dantasūcivedhak'ādīnaṃ likhanakāle mandamandaṃ rassaṃ kaḍḍhanto.
